mentions.name: LLM codebase course-corrector
mentions.description: An approach combining static analysis and review heuristics so LLMs can course-correct a codebase when they over-engineer or produce unwieldy abstractions; currently in the exploratory design phase.
mentions.problem: LLMs over-engineer or produce unwieldy abstractions in codebases.
mentions.source_excerpt: also spending a lot of time thinking about how you "close the loop" on software projects. right now figuring out how you can combine static analysis + review heuristics to let LLMs course correct the codebase when they over-engineer or produced unwieldy abstractions.

evidence.value: also spending a lot of time thinking about how you "close the loop" on software projects. right now figuring out how you can combine static analysis + review heuristics to let LLMs course correct the codebase when they over-engineer or produced unwieldy abstractions.
